title: TC-03 STAR FALL
summary: This is the third kit from Iron Toys, and it is inspired from Mobile Suit Gundam 00 just like the previous ones. I wouldn't say they copied those designs because there are lots of changes here and there and the quality of this kit is improved from its predecessors, in both design and snapfit.
body: This is the third kit from Iron Toys, and it is inspired from Mobile Suit Gundam 00 just like the previous ones. I wouldn't say they copied those designs because there are lots of changes here and there and the quality of this kit is improved from its predecessors, in both design and snapfit.

I only had troubles with the arms for a bit. The rest of the kit is straightforward with metal parts and plastic parts work quite well together. The color scheme is also a good one. From the pictures, you may see mostly black tone but the actual product would look better with shades of purple and some gold bits.

The railgun is truly amazing. Probably the best thing of this kit and I know many would agree. The shields can be skipped as you would need like three of them to look good, more would make it... a bit busy.

The worst thing about this kit is, again, the water slides. Its design is not bad, they do add the highlights to the body over all but the quality is still terrible. Be careful with them. Extremely careful.
